requirement_groups.wording: Referral eligibility: clinic catchment, residence and inclusion/exclusion criteria

requirement_groups.wording: Blood, ECG, X-ray, CT/MRI and sometimes SPECT assessed at hospital

requirement_groups.wording: Bring a referring physician's letter with prior medical course and prescriptions if previously seen elsewhere, where possible

live_specialty_page.wording_summary: Hand-delivered or mailed packet for non-EPIC Emory providers; no phone, email, fax, direct secure messaging for incoming referrals.

official_pdf.wording_summary: Hand-delivered or FedEx only, tracking number requested; not generic untracked mail. Form labeled March 2022.

general_emory_page.wording_summary: Emory general referral portal lists provider link/fax, but the specialist Cognitive Neurology page imposes stricter incoming-channel exclusions.

source_conflict.resolution_required: Contact authorized Emory Cognitive Neurology clinic referrer intake; until resolved, do not enable digital or postal referral from KIMSE. eConsult reply channel fields are outgoing from Emory to referring doctor, NOT incoming referral permission.
